WITH status_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    s.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scans,
    AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.chronotag::text BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(avg_size_per_minute) OVER () AS mean_status_avg
  FROM status_avgs
)
SELECT
  healtheval,
  total_scans,
  avg_size_per_minute,
  avg_size_per_minute - mean_status_avg AS difference_from_mean
FROM with_mean
WHERE mean_status_avg IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The average is over per-scan gbsize/spanmin ratios; rows with either value missing or spanmin equal to zero are excluded from that average. Status-level averages with no valid ratios are ignored when computing the mean, and statuses are omitted if no status-level average can be computed.
